key_insight: Plasma-sprayed Cr3C2 and Stellite coatings significantly improve Inconel 625 wear resistance, with Cr3C2 giving the best hardness and tribological performance.
engineering_relevance: The results support APS carbide-based coatings as a practical surface-engineering route for aerospace and power-generation components exposed to high-temperature wear.
method: APS deposited Cr3C2 and Stellite coatings on Inconel 625 substrates
Evaluated microstructure, hardness, friction, and wear using SEM, EDAX, and tribological testing
Used Taguchi L9 design with ANOVA to identify key wear-performance drivers
evidence_signal: Cr3C2 increased hardness from 505 HV to 720 HV and achieved the lowest wear loss (0.2%) and minimum specific wear rate at 200 °C.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated under the reported test conditions, so long-term durability, thermal cycling, and coating integrity under service loading still need validation.
paper_title: Optimization and Tribological Evaluation of Plasma-Sprayed Cr3C2 and Stellite Coatings on Inconel 625 using Taguchi-ANOVA Method
